current_runtime_branch: agent evaluates current idle OR safely shareable headroom; no retired runtime or zero-MiB gate
deadline_semantics: 无新的墙钟自动截止；仅实际计算总预算，等待与准备另记。
trigger: Read exact live state; only waiting_for_resources or waiting_for_connection with relevant new evidence may wake original trainer. No wake while checking/deploying/training/terminal/unknown. Old009 remains closed.
relevant_signals: 释放、余量变化和代表性低负载可作为复核线索，不等于共享安全或启动许可。
resource_review_note: GPU0既有工作近饱和，已出现同步竞争信号，尚无充分影响证据；不因同样空余显存/200ms暂停/未连续触发阈值而恢复。其他卡或实际负载变化仍可供执行Agent进一步复核，非要求0MiB。
